title: Running Down a Dreamland
author: Wes Eas
description: An entry in ShuffleComp: Disc 2. Inspired by :"The Big Strong Man" by The Big Strong Man, "Runnin' Down a Dream" by Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers, "Super Mario Bros OST" by Koji Kondo, and "1983...(A Merman I Should Turn To Be) / Moon, Turn the Tides...Gently Gently Away" by The Jimi Hendrix Experience.
